# Remaining Medium-Priority Architecture Guidance

## Task #16: Trait-Variant Macro Snapshot Tests

**Location:** Add to testing strategy section or create ADR-007

**Pattern:**
```rust
// tests/macro_snapshots/trait_variant_tests.rs
#[test]
fn test_pentest_tool_trait_signatures() {
    // Compile-time assertion that generated traits have expected bounds
    use static_assertions::assert_impl_all;
    
    // Local variant (no Send bound)
    trait LocalPentestTool {
        async fn execute(&self, spec: ProbeSpec) -> Result<RawOutput, ToolError>;
    }
    
    // Send variant (generated by trait-variant)
    trait PentestTool: Send {
        async fn execute(&self, spec: ProbeSpec) -> Result<RawOutput, ToolError>;
    }
    
    // Assert Send + Sync on the trait object
    assert_impl_all!(dyn PentestTool: Send);
    assert_impl_all!(Arc<dyn PentestTool>: Send, Sync);
}
```

Add to CI: `cargo test --test macro_snapshots` to catch trait bound drift.

## Task #19: InfraHandles Shutdown Ordering Test

**Location:** Add to integration tests

**Pattern:**
```rust
// tests/integration/shutdown_order.rs
#[tokio::test]
async fn test_panic_log_captured_during_shutdown() {
    // 1. Start system with InfraHandles tracking panic thread
    let (system, infra) = init_system().await;
    
    // 2. Spawn actor that panics late in shutdown sequence
    let actor = spawn_late_panicking_actor();
    
    // 3. Trigger shutdown: actors → sandbox → infra
    let shutdown_timeout = Duration::from_secs(5);
    system.shutdown(shutdown_timeout).await.unwrap();
    infra.shutdown(shutdown_timeout);  // Joins panic thread LAST
    
    // 4. Verify RunEvent::ActorPanicked was persisted
    let events = system.event_log.query_by_run(run_id).await;
    assert!(events.iter().any(|e| matches!(e, RunEvent::ActorPanicked { .. })));
    
    // 5. Verify process exited cleanly within timeout
    // (no hang waiting for panic thread)
}
```

This ensures the panic-log sink outlives all panic sources.

## Task #22: Encapsulate Startup Typestate in Builder

**Location:** Expand Startup vs. Runtime Boundary section

**Pattern:**
```rust
// api/src/startup.rs

/// Private typestate tokens (pub(crate) only)
pub(crate) struct StartupPhase;
pub(crate) struct RuntimePhase;

/// Public builder - stable API
pub struct SystemBuilder<Phase> {
    config: Config,
    _phase: PhantomData<Phase>,
}

impl SystemBuilder<StartupPhase> {
    pub fn new(config: Config) -> Self {
        SystemBuilder { config, _phase: PhantomData }
    }
    
    pub fn validate_policy(self) -> Result<SystemBuilder<PolicyValidated>, StartupError> {
        // Step 1: validate ToolCallPolicy
        Ok(SystemBuilder { config: self.config, _phase: PhantomData })
    }
}

impl SystemBuilder<PolicyValidated> {
    pub fn build_contract(self) -> Result<SystemBuilder<ContractSealed>, StartupError> {
        // Step 2: build ScopeContract (consumes validated policy token)
        Ok(SystemBuilder { config: self.config, _phase: PhantomData })
    }
}

impl SystemBuilder<ContractSealed> {
    pub fn finalize(self) -> Result<(System, RuntimePhase), StartupError> {
        // Final step: return runtime system
        Ok((System { /* ... */ }, RuntimePhase))
    }
}

/// Simple public API (hides typestate complexity)
pub fn init(config: Config) -> Result<System, StartupError> {
    SystemBuilder::new(config)
        .validate_policy()?
        .build_contract()?
        .finalize()
        .map(|(sys, _phase)| sys)
}
```

Typestate types stay `pub(crate)` → no API leakage when startup flow changes.

## Task #24: Heap Health Monitoring Strategy

**Location:** Add to Observability & Tracing section

**Pattern:**
```rust
// neoraptor-supervisor/src/heap_monitor.rs

pub struct HeapHealthTask {
    interval: Duration,
}

impl HeapHealthTask {
    pub async fn run(
        &self,
        actor_registry: Arc<ActorRegistry>,
        event_store: Arc<dyn EventStore>,
        coverage_maps: Arc<DashMap<RunId, CoverageMap>>,
    ) {
        let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(self.interval);
        
        loop {
            ticker.tick().await;
            
            // 1. Count strong refs for shared Arc types
            let scope_refs = actor_registry.scope_contract_strong_count();
            let artifact_count = event_store.artifact_count().await;
            let coverage_map_size = coverage_maps.len();
            
            // 2. Emit as tracing events
            tracing::info!(
                scope_refs,
                artifact_count,
                coverage_map_size,
                "Heap health snapshot"
            );
            
            // 3. Alert if unbounded growth detected
            if scope_refs > 100 {  // Threshold from config
                tracing::warn!(scope_refs, "Possible Arc cycle leak");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

**Dev tooling:**
- Add `pprof` to `[dev-dependencies]`
- Enable `tokio-console` in dev builds: `RUSTFLAGS="--cfg tokio_unstable"`
- Add `just heap-snapshot` recipe:
  ```justfile
  heap-snapshot:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=true cargo build --release
      heaptrack target/release/neoraptor-api
  ```

This provides lightweight production metrics + deep dev profiling.
